upgradeMessage: This feature requires a higher subscription plan.
heroLedePart1: {{localLabel}} keeps open-model work on your device. {{byokLabel}} sends only the requests you choose to your selected API provider, under that provider's billing and data terms. Both remain free, with no seat or card required.
heroLedePart2: AGI managed cloud is open in public alpha for individual use. Team is self-serve and billed per seat; Enterprise is sales-assisted when your organization wants custom governance and negotiated terms.
wedgeHeading: Private by default, on your terms.
wedgeLede: Local keeps work on your device. BYOK sends only the requests you choose to the provider you select, with a visible provider boundary before anything leaves the device.
localTierBody: Run a supported Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, or vLLM model on your laptop. After the runtime and model are installed, inference can work offline.
byokTierBody: Bring your own keys to 10+ supported providers, including your own OpenAI-compatible custom endpoints. Provider billing and data handling stay with your account.
byokFeature3: Visible provider label on every route
byokFeature4: Desktop, CLI, and VS Code where released
teamLede: This is what AGI is built to sell: shared, governed model access for the whole org, with the local wedge already proven by your engineers.
teamTierBody: Team is self-serve and billed per seat. Every seat gets Pro-level managed usage, plus shared workspaces and organization administration.
teamFeature1: Pro-level managed usage for every seat
teamFeature2: One organization invoice, billed per licensed seat
teamFeature3: Local, BYOK, and managed cloud access options
teamFeature4: Owner and admin roles with member management
teamFeature5: Email support, 1 business day first response
enterpriseBody: Discuss SSO/SCIM roadmap, audit needs, data retention, and a rollout scoped to how your org actually works. Reach out and we will plan it together.
enterpriseFeature2: Custom capacity, a named contact, and a 4-business-hour outage response target
enterpriseFeature3: SSO, audit, and data retention (roadmap, scoped with your team)
enterpriseFeature4: Annual contract with a dedicated account manager
individualHeading: Prefer to go solo? Cloud works there too.
individualLede: The same managed cloud that powers Team and Enterprise is available on its own, with plans that scale from a light daily trial up to heavy individual workloads.
freeTierBody: A small free monthly allowance to try AGI Cloud on our fastest economy models, no credit card required.
freeFeature3: Upgrade anytime as you need more
basicTierBody: The starting paid cloud plan for regular light work on Web, Mobile, and Desktop.
proTierBody: Five times Basic usage for professionals doing daily work across app and developer surfaces.
proFeature2: 4 chats at once and up to 150 connector tools
maxTierBody: Five times Pro usage for intensive daily multi-agent workloads.
waitlistBody: Managed Cloud is open in public alpha and Team has self-serve per-seat checkout. Leave your details for contract-scoped Enterprise requirements such as SSO, custom retention, and governance controls.
compareSubheading: Local and BYOK run on supported Desktop, CLI, and VS Code releases. Free through Max 15x are the individual cloud plans. Team adds shared access; Enterprise governance remains contract-scoped.
compareLocalBestFor: Offline, privacy-first individuals and IT-cautious companies
compareByokBestFor: Power users and companies who want zero markup
compareFreeBestFor: Trying AGI Cloud before you commit
compareBasicBestFor: Individuals doing regular light daily work
compareTeamBestFor: Teams needing shared, governed access with admin controls
compareEnterpriseUsage: Dedicated capacity, scoped to your org
compareEnterpriseBestFor: Organizations needing SSO, audit, and custom retention

max15xTierBody: Highest-capacity managed AI for sustained work.
heroLede: Free to start. Local and BYOK cost nothing from AGI, and managed cloud is priced per plan below.
freeLocalByok: Local models and your own API keys, always free
